message.content: I have what I need. HD's FY2023 (fiscal year ended Jan 2024) figures are solid: revenue $152.7B, operating income $21.7B (14.2% margin), net income $15.1B, diluted EPS $15.11, and operating cash flow $21.2B. At $385.43 that's ~25.5x trailing EPS — a reasonable multiple for a wide-moat retailer, and I hold no HD yet. Sizing to the mandate: 12 shares × $385.43 ≈ $4,625, under the $5,000 per-order cap and the only trade today.
